description:
Screen a ship by IMO number (7 digits, with or without the "IMO" prefix) or MMSI
(9 digits) across the lists that publish ship identifiers (OFAC SDN, UK, Swiss SECO,
Canada, Australia, French Trésor). Exact match, ignoring each list's formatting; each
match names the listed vessel. `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.
name: screen_vessel
title: Screen a vessel
